newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids at 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids at 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Austrian central bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on one-week repurchase agreements at an unchanged rate of 3.0 percent.
Bids have to be in by 1200 GMT on Thursday because of Friday's All Saints holiday, the bank said.

Last week, the Austrian National Bank allotted 5.83 billion schillings in repos, or seven percent of bids, also at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent. Austria's repo rate has been at that level since the beginning of September. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
